response.justification: Bogdan is a seasoned hands-on engineer with 13+ years of broad full-stack, distributed-systems and low-latency experience, plus some fintech exposure (RIDE Capital) and early agentic/MCP tooling work at re:cinq. However, the role is an executive CTO position and the resume shows no engineering management or organizational leadership — no evidence of hiring, scaling teams from 10 to 30+, building a technical leadership layer, board-level communication, or governing outsourced delivery partners. There is also no demonstrated production multi-agent AI system ownership, no AI/ML evaluation or real-time inference architecture, and no regulated credit-risk or working-capital systems experience. The gap between a staff-level IC profile and the required executive scope is too large for this search.
strengths: Deep backend/distributed-systems and low-latency microservices experience (Sociomantic, millions of req/s)
Early hands-on exposure to agentic AI infrastructure and MCP tooling at re:cinq
Founder of an open-source event-driven platform plus strong engineering-craft culture (TDD, CI/CD, teaching)
concerns: No engineering management or team-scaling track record; entirely individual-contributor career path
No production multi-agent AI systems, LLM evaluation, or real-time inference architecture experience
Minimal fintech-infrastructure depth (no credit risk, liquidity, or multi-jurisdiction compliance work)
